subject.title: [Feature]: Collapsible messages in Control UI chat

question: Should Control UI add inline collapse-by-default for ordinary long assistant Markdown messages, and what threshold/default-expanded policy should it use?
rationale: Current main deliberately solves truncated-history recovery through the side reader, while this issue asks for a separate inline chat-bubble behavior with UX, accessibility, and interaction-policy tradeoffs.

options.title: Define inline collapse policy first
options.body: Choose thresholds, latest-message behavior, code-block handling, and global controls before queueing implementation.

options.title: Treat side reader as enough for now
options.body: Leave ordinary assistant Markdown inline and close or defer inline collapse if maintainers prefer the existing canvas/sidebar reader model.

options.title: Prototype a narrow default
options.body: Allow a focused PR that collapses only completed assistant messages above a fixed line or character threshold, without new config.

recommendation.title: Define inline collapse policy first
recommendation.body: Choose thresholds, latest-message behavior, code-block handling, and global controls before queueing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI chat rendering and adjacent full-message-reader verification make steipete the best available routing candidate for the UX policy decision.
